description: A generously proportioned traditional bedroom in a soft, romantic palette. The room is architecturally formal with applied crown moulding along the ceiling perimeter and wide white window casings with plantation shutters on two symmetrically placed windows flanking the headboard wall. Brass curtain rods with finial ends hold floor-length panels of pale gray linen-weave drapery. The king bed has a tall upholstered panel headboard in warm cream or pale blush fabric with vertical channel-tufting and a slight wing on each side. The bed is dressed in dove gray bedding with matching decorative euro shams, two narrow striped pillows in gray and white, and a textured cream bolster lumbar pillow. On each side of the bed, a two-drawer nightstand in a washed sage blue-gray with a simple round brass knob holds a small book stack and a bottle. In the foreground, two plush barrel armchairs in a warm blush or dusty pink velvet face each other across a small round white plaster pedestal side table bearing a coffee cup and two books. A vintage-look floral or abstract area rug in muted rose, gray, and ivory tones warms the floor. The warm natural light filters through the closed plantation shutters, creating an even, soft ambient fill across the room. The palette is soft blush, sage blue-gray, warm cream, and brass.
